name: Showcase — comparativas en vivo
author: pasho
description: A long horizontal video out of a stream where two models get the same prompt: a trailer-style teaser, the greeting on the camera full screen, a jump card to the test, the news, the test, the results side by side and the verdict. Carries the recipes that build the opening.

recipes.label: Teaser (lo que viene)
recipes.description: Opens the video with a few moments from later on, as a trailer: black bars, a tracked label, dramatic music, and a hard cut into the greeting. Replaces the teaser it made before, and puts the camera intro and the jump card back in step.

moments.description: [{ "start": s, "end": s, "cuts": [[a, b]], "crop": { "x", "y", "w", "h" }, "title" }] in source seconds and pixels, in the order they play.

label.description: The words in the bottom bar.

music.description: Audio asset for the bed; defaults to the pack's own.

dissolve.description: Seconds of dissolve between teaser shots.

sequenceId.description: Which video; the first one when empty.

recipes.label: Cámara a pantalla completa
recipes.description: The first shot after the teaser opens on the camera full screen, holds, and eases into its corner, landing exactly on it.

region.description: The camera's rectangle in the stream, in source pixels.

inset.description: Pixels trimmed from the top of the region so the screen above never shows.

move.description: Seconds to settle into the corner.

item.description: The shot to open on; the first after the teaser when empty.

sequenceId.description: Which video; the first one when empty.

recipes.label: Aviso: bríncate a la prueba
recipes.description: A lower third telling the viewer at what minute the test starts, with the minute read off the timeline.

target.description: The item the jump lands on: the first shot of the test.

at.description: Seconds into the video it appears.

question.default: ¿SOLO QUIERES VER LA PRUEBA Y LOS JUEGOS?

lead.description: The big line, before the time.

sequenceId.description: Which video; the first one when empty.

quickActions.label: Armar el showcase
quickActions.text: Edit {selection} as a Showcase comparison: follow the pack's style guide for what stays and what goes, then open it with the teaser, camera-intro and jump-card recipes.
